title: AI token use may jump 78% as falling prices fail to guarantee lower costs
script:
AI token consumption is set to surge 78 percent over the next two years. Despite lower unit costs, enterprise spending is actually rising.
Companies are now processing far more data than ever before. Falling prices per token failed to guarantee lower total costs for businesses.
The reliance on AI is deepening as firms integrate these models into core workflows. Volume is effectively canceling out the price cuts from providers.
IT leaders are struggling to project long-term budgets as usage patterns remain volatile. Efficiency is not keeping pace with this rapid expansion.
The race for performance is driving this consumption spike. Would you sacrifice speed for lower AI bills?
